title: Machine Learning
reasons: Builds on linear algebra/probability and benefits from early-term optimization + programming; take after those foundations.

title: Optimization
reasons: Provides optimization foundations (gradient methods) used in ML/deep learning and many modeling courses; take before ML/deep learning electives.

title: Stochastic Process
reasons: Stochastic processes is theory-heavy and benefits from probability foundation; recommended after fundamentals.

title: Stochastic Simulation
reasons: Simulation benefits from probability/stochastic process preparation; recommended after those foundations as an applied complement.

title: Measure Theoretic Probability
reasons: Measure-theoretic probability is highly theoretical and is a good foundation for advanced theory (e.g., advanced statistics theory). Offer in Term 1 to spread workload across years and avoid stacking multiple heavy theory courses in the same Term 2.

title: Advanced Statistics Theory
reasons: Advanced theory should follow probability foundations; recommended after students have solid probability/statistics maturity (PhD/theory track).

title: Statistical Methods for Biomedical Research
reasons: Offer in Term 1 to support the biomedical pathway (MBI6005 → MBI6006) and avoid stacking both in the same late term. Students can then take ML foundations (e.g., optimization/Python) early and proceed to ML/biomedical ML electives smoothly.

title: Machine Learning for Biomedical Research
reasons: Biomedical ML is advanced; recommended after machine learning/statistical learning + programming foundations.

title: Python Programming
reasons: Programming-enabler; recommended early to support coding-heavy electives (ML, deep learning, NLP, data analysis/visualization).

title: Big Data Modeling and Management
reasons: Recommended early to build data engineering/big-data workflow before project-based and applied electives.

title: Data Visualization
reasons: Low prerequisite barrier; pairs well with Python and helps students communicate results throughout the programme.

title: Deep Learning and Their Applications
reasons: Deep learning is programming- and optimization-heavy; recommended after Python and core/statistical learning exposure.

title: Applied Regression Analysis
reasons: Applied regression is most valuable after required regression foundations; good follow-up consolidation course.

title: Time Series Analysis
reasons: Elective-Core; recommended early (no later than other electives) so students can take other electives (finance/ML/causal) with time series modeling as a tool.

title: Financial Data Analysis
reasons: Applied elective with broad utility; taking it early leaves room for advanced finance electives (risk/credit) later.

title: Quantitative Risk Management
reasons: Quant risk management is more effective after financial data analysis and solid probability/statistics preparation.

title: Credit Risk Modeling and Products
reasons: Credit risk modeling is advanced; recommended after finance/data foundations (and equivalent derivatives/investment background if applicable).

title: Bayesian & Computational Statistics
reasons: Required and foundational; supports downstream electives (Bayesian/computational methods used widely). Take at programme start.

title: Advanced Regression Methods
reasons: Required and foundational; establishes regression framework used by causal inference, time series, high-dimensional stats, etc. Take at programme start.

title: Multivariate Statistical Analysis
reasons: Elective-Core; recommended early (no later than other electives) because multivariate tools (PCA, classification, clustering) are assumed in many applied electives.

title: Statistical Learning
reasons: Elective-Core; recommended early (no later than other electives) because statistical learning underpins deep learning, NLP, AI/RL, and high-dimensional statistics.

title: Causal Inference
reasons: Causal inference relies on regression/probability foundations; recommended after required regression methods.

title: High-dimensional Statistics
reasons: High-dimensional statistics is advanced and benefits from regression + statistical learning background; recommended after those courses.

title: Capstone Project II
reasons: Designed for Term 2 to produce portfolio-ready work and support internship/job applications for the summer immediately after Term 2.

title: Capstone Project I
reasons: Designed for Term 2 to produce portfolio-ready work and support internship/job applications for the summer immediately after Term 2.

title: Internship Training
reasons: Internship Training is scheduled in Term 2 to align with internship/job search and summer placement immediately after Term 2.

title: Natural Language Processing
reasons: NLP benefits from prior ML/deep learning + programming; recommended after students have the core toolkit.

title: Artificial Intelligence
reasons: Broad AI overview fits well early and helps students choose follow-up electives (NLP/RL/deep learning).

title: Reinforcement Learning
reasons: Reinforcement learning is typically downstream of ML/AI basics; recommended after early-term AI/ML preparation.
